# Data Acquisition and Engineering

Student presentations in this chapter concern obtaining, exchanging, storing,
and programmatically accessing data.

**Topic example:**
[Working with an API](../topic/api/)

This example shows how to separate a documented data request from the analysis
and how to avoid exposing credentials or depending unnecessarily on a live
service.

**Topic presentation:**
[Accessing US Census Data](../topic/amanda-noe-census-data/) by Amanda Noe

This presentation introduces Census data sources and demonstrates using the
Census API in Python, loading an API key from a local `.env` file, and
converting returned data into pandas data frames for plots and maps.
